exact_semantics: Original all_proxy_pair_checks.true_adjacent_endpoint recognizes only nonparallel joins. A false value is NOT a statement that the contact is nonadjacent. Consecutive collinear point joins with old interval[1,1] and exact previous-end=next-start are legitimate true adjacent endpoints. The proof never uses this metadata flag to assert prepared-proxy simplicity; ancestry, masks, endpoint words and identities are unchanged.
